_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/AmalgamationPlates/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The frame (fr_*), the chute sections (ch_*), the plates (pl_*), their mercury dressing (pd_*), the amalgam in three states (am1_ .. am3_), the mercury trap (tr_*) and the spray pipe in each metal (pipecopper_ / pipelead_). 'mercury' is the mod's own provisional texture (the amalgam pan's). Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
